messages:
mike: Heads-up — after the 02:00 deploy we saw a ~6% drop in span coverage for the http_client service. looks like a change in the partition key for the ETL job.
ashley: Ugh. Any idea which change caused it? can we get a quick query that shows the regression window? :mag:
ravi: I ran a diff on yesterday vs day-before. root cause looks like the kafka->staging mapper started dropping traces with empty user_agent. attaching query.
observability-bot: alert: span_coverage_low on http_client (6% below baseline) — incident created: INC-2026-347
mike: Query ravi mentioned (paste):
```
SELECT date, count(span_id) as spans
FROM traces.staging
WHERE service = 'http_client' AND date >= '2026-03-20'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date;
```
jun: Thanks — ran it locally, confirms drop at 2026-03-21 01:58 UTC which matches deploy. I can reproduce with a small payload.
ashley: Ok next steps: 1) temporary rollback rule for the mapper 2) create a remediation ticket with owner and ETA 3) add regression test to CI for empty user_agent handling.
mike: I'll open the rollback PR and cut a canary. assigning @mike to rollback. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/etl/pull/412
ravi: I'll own the remediation fix (update mapper to tolerate empty user_agent). ETA: EOD tomorrow. adding test change to same PR.
jun: I'll own validation / analytics side — add assert in the ETL smoke job and a replay job to reprocess missing spans. ETA: Wed COB.
ashley: Great. Can we make this a tracked action item in the postmortem board with recurring reminders? I want ownership rotation so this doesn't recur when pm shifts.
ashley: Proposed actions (brief):
- A1: rollback mapper change (mike) — immediate
- A2: code fix + unit test for empty user_agent (ravi) — due 2026-03-25
- A3: replay missing spans for 2026-03-21 window (jun) — due 2026-03-26
- A4: add regression to nightly CI + alert threshold (observability team) — due 2026-04-01
- A5: add monthly recurrence check for span coverage drift (oncall rotation) — automation by observability-bot
mike: Rollback cut, canary running, rolling back mapper config in infra. will monitor for 30m and then promote.
oncall-bot: scheduled: monitor-span-coverage job started (30m) — will post results in #incidents
ravi: Created GH issue and linked PR to it: https://github.com/redwood-inference/etl/issues/1980 — assigning myself. Added label: observability-regression
jun: Started a replay job for the affected partition (small batch first). logs show re-ingest of ~2.3k spans so far.
ashley: For the postmortem follow-up board: please add a single owner per action, acceptance criteria, and estimated timeline. I'll be the PM to ensure closure and will rotate long-term ownership into the infra-oncall rota after we verify fix for 2 weeks.
mike: Noted. I'll update the rollback PR with a blurb linking to the postmortem task.
ravi: ETA still EOD tomorrow for code fix. will ping when PR is ready for review.
jun: Replay completed for the small batch; scheduling full replay for tonight at 03:00 UTC (low traffic window). I'll post completion summary.
observability-bot: replay-job-report: small batch reprocessed 2300 spans, success rate 100%. queued full replay for 2026-03-21 window at 03:00 UTC.
ashley: To prevent recurring pattern: suggest we add a small set of metric checks to the deployment gating: span-coverage delta < 1% for 10m after deploy, failing gate if not met.
mike: Agree. I'll add a gating proposal to infra deploy docs and link the PR.
jun: Also suggest an aggregation correctness test — run a sampled end-to-end from ingestion to dashboard for a few synthetic traces before deploy.
ashley: Great. I'll convert all of the above into epics/tasks in the postmortem board: cover owner, due date, acceptance criteria. tagging this thread INC-2026-347 for traceability.
mike: Thanks everyone. I'll post an update in 1h with canary status.
oncall-bot: monitor-span-coverage job: no regression detected in 30m canary window — canary healthy. :white_check_mark:
jun: Full replay completed: re-ingested ~12.4k spans for 2026-03-21 window, dashboards reconciled, coverage back to baseline.
ravi: Pushed fix branch with tests, requesting review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/etl/pull/413
ashley: Awesome. Closing immediate incident, but keeping postmortem action items open until we have CI gating + monthly recurrence check. will follow up in board. :sparkles:
mike: Closing thread on Slack; we'll keep updates on the postmortem board and repo issues. thanks all. :thumbsup:
